status: x-y-time-only 100-m fine-place × speed-turn feasibility preflight frozen before any 100-m vertical outcome
role: post-freeze exploratory spatial-localization stress test; opened after positive 250-m results; not independent confirmation

feasibility.target_support: A target endpoint is supported when its 100-m cell × speed×turn state occurs in at least one other session of the same individual and in at least one session from another individual in the same cohort.
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 supported endpoints
feasibility.panel_gate: retain at least 70% of the frozen 250-m baseline n and at least 5 individuals in every panel
feasibility.decision: If all three panels pass, freeze exact n and open a 100-m vertical stress test. Otherwise stop before any 100-m vertical outcome.

planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.estimator: P(centered residual height | 100-m cell, speed×turn state), equal-session self, equal-individual other, identical self-derived joint-stratum weights
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.calibration: reuse frozen whole-session permutation B/seeds from the corresponding speed×turn analyses
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight n; calibrated identity >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 3/3 PASS => in those systems, route/resource allocation at scales >=100 m remains insufficient; mixed/0 => localization boundary is between 100 and 250 m.

claim_boundary: 100-m cells are still matching strata, not exact paths or resources.
This stress test was opened after positive 250-m results and is not independent confirmation.
No inference to P2023 or Eidolon.
stop_rule: Do not change 100-m grid, speed2_turn2 definition, 70% gate, >=5 floor, 50-event support or panel set after preflight output.
If any panel fails the support gate, stop before vertical outcome.
Do not invent a 150-m or other intermediate grid.
